paragraphs: Quantcast builds AI-powered advertising technology that optimises digital ad auctions in real time, delivering measurable outcomes for marketers worldwide. My work on built scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras mirrors that.
Built scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deployed as FastAPI services in Docker.
XGBoost churn classifier in R (tidymodels) with two‑stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE inside the recipe and MCC evaluation.
